_comment: Entra ID security groups of record for the InfoSec Assurance Foundry platform (team/TEAM_MODEL.md §6; delta D-T3 applied). All groups: securityEnabled=true, mailEnabled=false, assigned membership (no dynamic rules), isAssignableToRole=false, covered by Entra access reviews. UPNs are placeholders; object ids are filled by scripts/provision_identity.sh into team/rbac.parameters.json. The owner owns only the groups he uses to run the team; every group that grants him privilege or approves his changes is owned by the line manager (executed by {group:iam-admins}). Controls: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.3, A.5.15, A.5.16, A.5.18, A.8.2; DORA Art. 9(4)(c); NIS2 Art. 21(2)(i).

conditionalAccessPolicy.name: CA-InfoSec-Foundry
cloudApps: Azure AI Foundry / Azure Cognitive Services

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-users
groups.purpose: Assurance users: Azure AI User (or the agent-consumer custom role) on the Foundry project; SharePoint site members; Copilot Studio agent audience; hosted-MCP Easy Auth allowed group; GitHub Read; CA policy scope
groups.additionsRequestedBy: line manager of the joiner via access package AP-InfoSec-Foundry-User (12 months)
grants: SharePoint Members (site): Edit on GRC/TPA/Active, Read on Reports/, Templates/, Governance/
MCP local (own az login) / hosted (Easy Auth)

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-report-approvers
groups.purpose: Tier A peer four-eyes approvers (REPORT_DELIVERY reportTypes DeepSearch, AIDeepSearch, EvidenceAnalysis, SOCSummary, PentestSummary, ThreatIntelBrief, Transcript, Advisory; JIRA_CREATE, IAF_SUBMIT, TEAMS_POST); the approval flow resolves this group minus the requester
grants: May answer Tier A approval gates (team/approval-policy.json)

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-senior-approvers
groups.purpose: Tier B senior four-eyes approvers (REPORT_DELIVERY reportTypes InfoSecTPA-DPO, CyberForum, CISOGlobal, CISOExecSummary — deliverables that leave the team); the deputy also approves the owner's own Tier C items (TEMPLATE_UPDATE, PLATFORM_CHANGE review, MEMORY_DELETE)
grants: May answer Tier B gates; deputy answers Tier C gates where requestedBy is the owner (approval-policy.json tiers.C.requester_is_owner_fallback)

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-owner
groups.purpose: Standing low-privilege owner roles only: Reader (RG), Log Analytics Reader, Key Vault Reader (names, not values), SharePoint site owner, Copilot Studio maker, GitHub Maintain; no standing privileged Azure role
grants: Tier C approver of others' TEMPLATE_UPDATE / PLATFORM_CHANGE / MEMORY_DELETE items

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-admin-pim
groups.purpose: PIM-eligible privileged Azure roles for platform maintenance (ledger rows L1–L5, L7, L8: Azure AI Developer, Contributor, Key Vault Secrets Officer, Logic Apps Standard Developer/Operator, Website Contributor, Storage Blob Data Reader, Monitoring Contributor, Bing Contributor); nobody active by default

pim.approverForActivation: self-activation for Azure AI Developer / Key Vault / Logic Apps / Function / Monitoring / Blob roles; {upn:line-manager} approval for Contributor (RG)

grants: see team/rbac.bicep (pim* resources; perm* resources only when enablePim=false — exception recorded in team/ACCESS_REGISTER.md)

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-breakglass
groups.purpose: Eligible-only membership granting the -admin-pim role set (no RBAC Administrator) to the deputy for a bounded window when the owner is unavailable > 2 business days or during a P1/P2 incident (operations/access-governance/BREAK_GLASS.md)

accessReview.cadence: each activation reviewed by {upn:francisco.gomes} within 5 business days; quarterly by {upn:line-manager}

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-readers
groups.purpose: Read-only evidence access for ISMS / internal audit and the DPO per engagement (ledger row L15); empty outside engagements

accessReview.cadence: end of each engagement (remove); quarterly check that it is empty

servicePrincipals.name: {app:infosec-foundry-deployer}
servicePrincipals.type: app registration with federated credential (GitHub Actions OIDC, environment production, repo {github:org/repo}) — no client secret, no interactive sign-in
roles: Role Based Access Control Administrator (RG, ABAC-constrained to the roles in team/rbac.bicep)
